ruleDefinitions.name: Shadow Copies Creation Using Operating Systems Utilities
ruleDefinitions.description: Shadow Copies creation using operating systems utilities, possible credential access

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vssadmin\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "wmic\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "VSSADMIN\.EXE")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*shadow.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*")))
